description: Your record collection as a local database: pick tonight's record, subtract your shelf from a crate-digging search, and price your wantlist without a token.

tools.name: artists_get
tools.description: Get an artist. Required: artist_id. Returns the ArtistsGetResponse.

tools.name: artists_releases
tools.description: List an artist's discography. Required: artist_id. Optional: sort, sort_order, per_page (default: 50) (plus 1 more). Returns the ArtistsReleasesResponse.

tools.name: collection_folders
tools.description: List the folders in a user's Discogs collection. Required: username. Returns the folder array, each with id, name, and count; folder 0 is the special 'All' folder holding every record. Works without a token when the collection is public. Call this first to discover folder ids, then pass one to collection_releases.

tools.name: collection_releases
tools.description: List the records inside one folder of a user's collection. Required: username, folder_id (use 0 for every record in the collection). Optional: sort, sort_order, per_page (max 100), page. Returns a paginated releases array with each record's release id, title, artists, year, labels, and formats. Works without a token when the collection is public.

params.name: folder_id
params.description: Folder id; 0 means every record in the collection

tools.name: database_search
tools.description: Search the Discogs database for releases, masters, artists, or labels — the main discovery endpoint. All parameters are optional: q (free text), type (release/master/artist/label), artist, label, genre, style, country, year, format, catno, barcode, plus per_page and page. Returns a paginated results array with each match's id, type, title, year, label, format, and thumbnail. Use this to find records matching a crate-digging brief; use releases_get or masters_get when you already have an id.

params.name: q
params.description: Free-text query across titles and artists

params.name: title
params.description: Match on combined artist and title

params.name: release_title
params.description: Match on the release title alone

params.name: label
params.description: Record label name, e.g. Blue Note

params.name: genre
params.description: Top-level genre, e.g. Jazz, Electronic, Rock

params.name: style
params.description: Finer style, e.g. Hard Bop, Ambient, Post Punk

params.name: country
params.description: Country of release, e.g. US, UK, Japan

params.name: year
params.description: Release year, or a range like 1960-1969

params.name: format
params.description: Physical format, e.g. Vinyl, LP, Album, 7'

params.name: catno
params.description: Catalogue number printed on the sleeve or label

params.name: barcode
params.description: Barcode, useful for scanning a record in a shop

tools.name: identity_get
tools.description: Show which Discogs account the current token belongs to. Returns the IdentityGetResponse.

tools.name: labels_get
tools.description: Get a record label. Required: label_id. Returns the LabelsGetResponse.

tools.name: labels_releases
tools.description: List a label's catalogue. Required: label_id. Optional: per_page (default: 50), page (default: 1). Returns the LabelsReleasesResponse.

tools.name: marketplace_price-suggestions
tools.description: Suggested prices by media condition (requires a token). Required: release_id. Returns the MarketplacePriceSuggestionsResponse.

tools.name: marketplace_stats
tools.description: Get the current lowest asking price and the number of copies for sale for one release. Required: release_id. Optional: curr_abbr (currency, e.g. USD, GBP, EUR). Returns num_for_sale, lowest_price, and blocked_from_sale. Keyless — no token needed. Note this is the lowest price a seller is currently ASKING, not a sale price and not an appraisal; use marketplace_price-suggestions (token required) for condition-graded guidance.

params.name: curr_abbr
params.description: Currency for the price, e.g. USD, GBP, EUR

tools.name: masters_get
tools.description: Get a master record, the abstract work behind all its pressings. Required: master_id. Returns the MastersGetResponse.

tools.name: masters_versions
tools.description: List every pressing of a master, for comparing issues and countries. Required: master_id. Optional: country, format, label (plus 2 more). Returns the MastersVersionsResponse.

params.name: country
params.description: Filter versions by country of release

tools.name: releases_get
tools.description: Get one specific pressing of a record. Required: release_id. Optional: curr_abbr. Returns the ReleasesGetResponse.

params.name: release_id
params.description: Discogs release id, identifying one specific pressing

params.name: curr_abbr
params.description: Currency for any prices, e.g. USD, GBP, EUR

tools.name: releases_rating
tools.description: Get a user's rating for a release. Required: release_id, username. Returns the ReleasesRatingResponse.

tools.name: users_get
tools.description: Get a user profile. Required: username. Returns the UsersGetResponse.

tools.name: wantlist_get
tools.description: List the records on a user's Discogs wantlist. Required: username. Optional: per_page (max 100), page. Returns a paginated wants array with each record's release id, title, artists, year, and the note and rating the user attached. Works without a token when the wantlist is public. Pair with marketplace_stats to price the wantlist.
